title: spec(translation): an approval node has no translation key — `flows` carries `screens.NODE` and `refusals.NODE` only, so a pack's approval-step label is refused `translation-target-unknown` (Seam: plugin-approvals reads it; split from #24863)
body:
**Filing gate ①: a product defect with reach measured**, split from #24863 by triage (R539) at the `domain:services` seat's request (`6290681512`). Filed by the triage seat (#6015, `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U`). ⛔ Not a claim.

**Reader (who acts):** the `domain:spec` seat. `Seam:` spec declares the key, and `plugin-approvals` reads it (the reader is #24863's services half).

## The gap (`origin/main`)

- `packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts`: `TranslationItemSchema.flows` carries `label`, `successMessage`, `errorMessage`, `screens.NODE` (screen nodes only) and `refusals.NODE` (refused end nodes only). No key names an approval node.
- **Measured** by the HotCRM dev for objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2060 item 13 (row C-15), in PR objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2199: `pnpm validate` refuses `flows.opportunity_approval.screens.manager_review.title` with `translation-target-unknown`, because the node "declares as a `approval` node, not a `screen`, so nothing resolves these keys".
- **Reach:** every non-English user who reads an approval's current step, in any app that ships an approval flow (HotCRM ships six flows with seven step nodes).

## Done when

- `flows.FLOW` gains a key for an approval node's label, spelled by the spec seat in the shape of `screens.NODE` / `refusals.NODE`. `os validate` accepts it for approval nodes and refuses it on other node types.
- `Clause-②: yes (widening)`, `minor`, with contract review at tier. Under the standing 甲 rule (#6015 `6292005854`), a widening ships in any 18.x minor.
- The reader that renders it in the reader's locale lands in #24863, either serial after this card or riding this PR by the seam's convention.

## Dedupe

The parent is #24863, whose own dedupe found 11 closed approval-label cards, none of them about localization. **New.**
